text: Quang Tri unveils 103 priority investment projects
The People's Committee of central Quang Tri province has approved a list of 103 priority projects for investment promotion during the 2026-2030 period.

The portfolio spans multiple sectors, including two in energy, three in logistics, 38 in tourism, services and trade, seven in green and high-tech agriculture, 32 in industrial, industrial park and production infrastructure, among others.
This structure indicates that Quang Tri is directing its investment promotion efforts across a wide range of sectors, with a strong focus on industry and tourism.
These two areas are expected to create new momentum for production, services and employment while helping unlock the province's economic potential.

In the industrial and production infrastructure sector, the list includes projects to develop and operate infrastructure for Bau Quang 1, Bau Quang 2 and Bau Quang 3 industrial parks, Cam Lien Industrial Park, the expanded Bac Dong Hoi Industrial Park, and several other production infrastructure projects.
Notably, Bau Quang 1 Industrial Park in Trieu Phong Commune is planned to cover 400 hectares, while Bau Quang 2 and Bau Quang 3 are expected to span 300 hectares and 75 hectares, respectively.
These projects aim to expand the province's industrial land bank, attract manufacturing and business investment, and gradually create additional space for industrial development.
The portfolio also includes projects focused on agricultural processing, high-tech applications and supporting industries.
This approach is intended to strengthen linkages between raw material production, processing and product distribution, thereby increasing value-added across the production chain.
One of the most notable features of the investment list is the tourism, services and trade segment, which comprises 38 projects spread across multiple localities.
These projects focus on resort development, eco-tourism, golf courses, accommodation services, entertainment facilities and the promotion of local natural and cultural assets.
In the logistics sector, Quang Tri has prioritized three projects: Ben Quan Logistics Center, South Dong Ha Logistics Service Center and the Ba Don Logistics Service Area.
The Ben Quan Logistics Center, located in Ben Quan Commune, is planned to cover 100 ha and is envisioned as an integrated logistics hub.
It will support transportation, warehousing, storage and distribution activities while strengthening links between production areas, processing facilities and consumer markets.
The energy portfolio includes the Quang Tri Combined-Cycle Gas Turbine Power Plant in the Southeast Quang Tri Economic Zone, with a planned capacity of 340 MW.
Another key project is a waste-to-energy plant in Nam Trach Commune, designed to process 600 tonnes of solid waste per day and generate 15 MW of electricity.
